args.summary: Completed and generated the four-span (35+45+45+35 m) cast-in-place continuous prestressed box girder bridge model with two bearing springs per support line and three modeled twin-column piers. The 2D spine-beam model passed KG L1/L2/L3 checks. Section A=6.712 m², I=4.4982 m⁴; girder self-weight=174.512 kN/m. Modal first vertical frequency f1=2.6604 Hz, giving impact factor μ=0.1572. Generated OpenSeesPy script at ${PROJECT_ROOT}/runs_luna/C5/C07_r2/C07_model.py. Analysis results: maximum positive lane moment 11,538.88 kN·m and maximum negative lane moment −9,596.87 kN·m.
